short_description: Solutionreach is a patient engagement platform providing automated appointment reminders, recalls, and patient communication.
long_description: Solutionreach is a comprehensive patient relationship management platform serving medical, dental, and vision practices. The platform provides automated appointment reminders, recall campaigns, two-way texting, reputation management, and patient surveys. Solutionreach integrates with major practice management systems and focuses on reducing no-shows and improving patient retention. Note that Solutionreach is primarily a patient communication platform rather than a video telehealth solution.
